name: combobox-09
description: Controlled combobox whose selected value is mirrored below with a reset action.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Combobox, ComboboxContent, ComboboxEmpty, ComboboxInput, ComboboxItem, ComboboxList, } from "@workspace/ui/components/combobox" const regions = [ "Frankfurt (eu-central-1)", "Dublin (eu-west-1)", "Virginia (us-east-1)", "Oregon (us-west-2)", "Singapore (ap-southeast-1)", ] export default function ControlledRegionReadout() { const [value, setValue] = React.useState(regions[0]!) return (
No regions found. {(item: string) => ( {item} )}
Deploying to: {value ?? "none"}
) }
